title: All 9 present forms of पठ्; we two, you all, they

video.title: लकार और पठ् धातु रूप - एक सरल समझ
video.focus: Watch for the 3 x 3 grid of पठ् forms in लट् लकार (present tense) and say each row along with her.

recap: Your Day 15 quiz answers didn't come in, so start with this warm-up. W1: Say 'I go' in Sanskrit. W2: Which is right: त्वं पठामि or त्वं पठसि? W3: Translate: What is your name?
idea: So far you have three forms: पठति (he reads), पठसि (you read), पठामि (I read). All of them are about **one** person. Today you add **two** and **many**.
## Number (वचन)
**Number** (वचन vacana) tells how many people do the action. Sanskrit has three:
- एकवचन ekavacana - singular: one
- द्विवचन dvivacana - dual: exactly two
- बहुवचन bahuvacana - plural: three or more
**Hindi has no dual.** Hindi says वे दो पढ़ते हैं with the plural. Sanskrit has a separate form just for two: तौ पठतः।
## The 9 forms of पठ् (present tense)
Read each row as one - two - many:
- **he/she:** पठति - पठतः - पठन्ति
- **you:** पठसि - पठथः - पठथ
- **I/we:** पठामि - पठावः - पठामः
Notice: the **I/we** row always has a long **ā** (पठा-). The dual endings are -तः, -थः, -वः; most plurals end in -न्ति, -थ, -मः.
## The pronouns that go with them
- सः sa (he) - तौ tau (those two) - ते te (they)
- त्वम् tvam (you) - युवाम् yuvām (you two) - यूयम् yūyam (you all)
- अहम् aham (I) - आवाम् āvām (we two) - वयम् vayam (we)
For women: सा - ते - ताः. Yes, ते again: for two women it is ते, for many men it is also ते. The verb shows which: ते पठतः (two) vs ते पठन्ति (many).
Every verb from Day 14 works the same way: गच्छति - गच्छतः - गच्छन्ति, वदामि - वदावः - वदामः.
The video calls this table लट् लकार. A **lakāra** is one of Sanskrit's ten tense/mood sets; लट् is the present. You'll meet the others later, so don't worry if the video names more.

sayAloud.meaning: Those boys run. (बालकाः = boys, plural of बालकः; more on Day 17)
Today I read a book. Your turn: one sentence about your own day, e.g. अद्य वयं गृहं गच्छामः।

quiz.q: How do you say 'We (three or more) read'?
quiz.why: वयम् (we, many) takes -आमः: पठामः. पठावः is for two; पठन्ति is 'they'.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: ते ___। (They read.)

quiz.why: आवाम् = we two; युवाम् = you two; तौ = those two.

quiz.q: Which verb form goes with युवाम्?
quiz.why: युवाम् (you two) takes the dual -थः. पठथ is 'you all'; पठतः is 'those two'.

quiz.q: Translate into Sanskrit: You all go.
quiz.why: यूयम् (you all) + गच्छथ. Before a consonant, यूयम् is written यूयं.
